title: Pulse — engineering operations for issues, incidents and roadmaps
description: A light, spring-animated landing page for an engineering operations platform. In the hero you scrub a playhead along a heartbeat line through the week and the issue board rewinds, cards springing between columns as an incident spikes on Wednesday. A swipeable triage deck, a pinned incident story, a roadmap with rolling initiative progress and a plan picker follow.
sections: Hero with week scrubber and board
features: Week scrubber: drag, keys or autoplay replay the board with shared-layout springs
Heartbeat timeline computed from issue history, with a pausable autoplay
Swipeable triage deck (accept to cycle or close)
Hold-to-declare incident, paging status, runbook checklist and postmortem timeline
Now / Next / Later roadmap with spring progress bars
